gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-mono: Tight and striking, Expose packs its capitals close against the lowercase with barely a pause. Noto Sans Mono does the opposite job, spacing its sturdy sans-serif letters so generously that nothing ever bumps.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Striking and refined, Expose keeps its capitals and lowercase almost shoulder to shoulder. Noto Sans Nag Mundari reads sturdily over many lines, its lowercase rivaling the capitals and its curves looking half unwrapped.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Noto Sans Nandinagari brings short ascenders and a big lowercase body to sit beneath Expose. Noto Sans Nandinagari reads gently line after line, its openings staying generous at every weight.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-hungarian: Expose compresses its cadence until there is barely a pause between letters, striking and refined. Noto Sans Old Hungarian does the reverse, keeping its counters large and its apertures open even at tiny sizes.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Noto Sans Old Italic keeps its curve endings well apart. Beside Expose, whose capitals and lowercase nearly touch in height, the pair's single standout is how tightly both hold that small gap.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ara: Compressed and striking up top, Expose barely pauses between letters. Noto Sans Old North Arabian lays down a dense, tall lowercase band, its terminals pointing outward like tongs, so extended reading feels steady and approachable.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: A near-seamless step from lowercase to capitals defines Expose. Expose packs its rhythm tight for impact, while Noto Sans Old Permic stays rounded and clearly open to the side.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-osage: Striking from the first glance, Expose compresses its cadence with very little pause. Noto Sans Osage stands out for lowercase bowls that fill the line like inflated shapes, its sweeping curves never closing up.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Barely any gap separates lowercase from capitals in Expose, giving its striking letters a compressed cadence with almost no pause. Noto Sans Palmyrene reads cleanly line by line, its curves stopping short.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Expose packs its striking letters tight, with a compressed cadence. Noto Sans PhagsPa then adds see-through c openings and a gentle bump up to capitals, loosening the page without losing any refinement.
